avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (Panax)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive hypoglycemic effects; may potentiate insulin secretion and glucose lowering
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor blood glucose closely if co-use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Independent hypoglycemic properties; synergistic glucose-lowering effect with glipizide
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to discontinue fenugreek; monitor for hypoglycemic episodes

avoid_supplements.name: Chromium (high-dose >200mcg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances insulin sensitivity and glucose utilization; additive hypoglycemic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose chromium supplementation; recommend <200mcg daily if used

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May improve insulin sensitivity and reduce blood glucose; mild additive effect possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; may require glipizide dose adjustment if added

caution_supplements.name: Bitter melon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Contains compounds that may increase insulin secretion; modest hypoglycemic potential
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient to report hypoglycemic symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive/chronic use)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Impairs hepatic glucose production and glipizide metabolism; increases hypoglycemic risk and hepatotoxicity
avoid_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol to ≤1 drink/day for women, ≤2 drinks/day for men; avoid binge drinking

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and glipizide absorption; prolongs onset of action
caution_foods.action: Counsel to take glipizide 15-30 minutes before meals for optimal efficacy

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase glipizide levels; clinical significance varies
caution_foods.action: Recommend avoiding grapefruit juice; monitor for increased hypoglycemic effects if consumed

monitoring_notes: Monitor fasting and postprandial blood glucose regularly, as supplements and foods may alter glipizide efficacy and increase hypoglycemia risk. Counsel patients on recognizing hypoglycemic symptoms and maintaining consistent meal timing since glipizide is rapid-acting.
